description: In every PA-model, folding a constructed list with initial accumulator \(z\) is folding its tail with the updated accumulator.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto_cons_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program 2)
  (a c z : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto h).value
      ![Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value ![a, c], z] =
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto h).value ![c, h.value ![a, z]]
